scripts.format:go: gofmt -w services infra/spikes/sst-viability/service infra/spikes/sst-db-viability/service spikes/openapi-library-selection spikes/environment-resolution
scripts.format:check:go: test -z "$(gofmt -l services infra/spikes/sst-viability/service infra/spikes/sst-db-viability/service spikes/openapi-library-selection spikes/environment-resolution)"
scripts.sst:deploy:db: npm run sst:build-image:db && sst deploy --stage db-viability
scripts.sst:diff:db: npm run sst:build-image:db && sst diff --stage db-viability
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:infra && npm run test:workflow-poll && npm run test:assertions-tooling && npm run test:environment-release
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:go
scripts.verify:go: set -e; for service in services/api services/worker services/local-agent services/mcp services/request-runtime infra/spikes/sst-viability/service infra/spikes/sst-db-viability/service spikes/openapi-library-selection spikes/environment-resolution; do (cd "$service" && go test ./... && go vet ./...); done && (cd spikes/openapi-library-selection && go test -c -o /tmp/kurier-openapi-selection.test) && (cd spikes/environment-resolution && go test -c -o /tmp/kurier-environment-resolution.test)
scripts.test:environment-execution: python3 -B scripts/environment-deploy/test_unit.py && python3 -B scripts/environment-deploy/test_credentials.py && python3 -B scripts/environment-deploy/test_paths.py && python3 -B scripts/environment-deploy/test_policy_review.py && node scripts/environment-deploy/frontend.test.mjs
